title: Repo Terms
description: repo-terms/v1 — the terms document carried in Agreement.terms for a per-pair repo agreement, base64 on the wire and identified by Agreement.termsType. Co-signed contract zone: fixed at proposal. Per-trade economics live on each trade-booked / trade-proposed event, not here.

borrower.description: Party id of the cash borrower (pledger role, A).

lender.description: Party id of the cash lender (receiver role, B; the agreement owner).

cashAssetId.description: Optional. Informational only: the pair does not lock its trades to one cash asset. Each trade names its cash on its purchase and repurchase prices, and the receiver affirms it per trade.

eligible.description: Securities the lender accepts as collateral, each with its haircut schedule.

maxOpenTrades.description: Checked by the apps, not by a guard: guards cannot count open trades cheaply.

limits.description: Operational limits. maxBaskets from the 5.5 draft is gone: a basket exists per trade.

cutOffMinutes.description: Minutes before leg 1 after which a trade may no longer be cancelled in the apps; the guard's own cut-off is execution-requested.

collateralMode.description: The pair's default collateral mode; a booking may override it. lender-account when absent. An external pair (external) holds the collateral on the calculation agent's own platform: FinP2P sees only the basket token it registers and the cash.
